disciplinary_grounds.description: Acts or attempted acts defined as unprofessional conduct by the board, including violations of ch. 450 or 961 and failure to report as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Those acts or attempted acts of commission or omission defined as unprofessional conduct by the board under the authority delegated to the board by s. 15.08 (5) (b).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence in treatment of a patient, as determined through disciplinary hearing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board may, when it determines that a panel established under s. 655.02, 1983 stats., has unanimously found or a court has found that a person has been negligent in treating a patient or when it finds a person guilty of unprofessional conduct or negligence in treatment, do one or more of the following: warn or reprimand that person, or limit, suspend or revoke any license or certificate granted by the board to that person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physician violation of s. 448.30 (informed consent requirements)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An allegation that a physician has violated s. 253.10 (3), 448.30 or 450.13 (2) ... is an allegation of unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to mail or present a medical certification required under s. 69.18 (2) within prescribed timeframes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to mail or present a medical certification required under s. 69.18 (2) within 21 days after the pronouncement of death of the person who is the subject of the required certificate ... is an allegation of unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure by a physician to report as required under s. 448.115 (duty to report another physician's unprofessional conduct)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a physician to report as required under s. 448.115.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may require physical, mental, or professional competency examinations and consider results during investigation or hearing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may require a person holding a license or certificate to undergo and may consider the results of one or more physical, mental or professional competency examinations if the board believes that the results of any such examinations may be useful to the board in conducting its investigation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving fees, commissions, rebates for referrals or professional services not actually rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no person licensed or certified under this subchapter may give or receive, directly or indirectly, to or from any person, firm or corporation any fee, commission, rebate or other form of compensation or anything of value for sending, referring or otherwise inducing a person to communicate with a licensee in a professional capacity, or for any professional services not actually rendered personally or at his or her direction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to render individual billing statements as required by s. 448.08 (2)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person licensed under this subchapter who renders any medical or surgical service or assistance whatever ... shall ... render an individual statement or account of the charges therefor directly to such patient, distinct and separate from any statement or account by any physician or other person

definition_quote.value: To examine into the fact, condition or cause of human health or disease, or to treat, operate, prescribe or advise for the same, by any means or instrumentality; to apply principles or techniques of medical sciences in the diagnosis or prevention; to penetrate, pierce or sever the tissues of a human being; or to hold oneself out as able to do any such acts.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine and surgery" means: (a) To examine into the fact, condition or cause of human health or disease, or to treat, operate, prescribe or advise for the same, by any means or instrumentality. (b) To apply principles or techniques of medical sciences in the diagnosis or prevention of any of the conditions described in par. (a) and in sub. (2). (c) To penetrate, pierce or sever the tissues of a human being. (d) To offer, undertake, attempt or do or hold oneself out in any manner as able to do any of the acts described in this subsection.

methods_authorized.quote: To examine into the fact, condition or cause of human health or disease, or to treat, operate, prescribe or advise for the same, by any means or instrumentality.

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe drugs, including opioid antagonists; controlled substance prescribing governed by ch. 450 and 961
drug_authority.quote: Any act by a physician in violation of ch. 450 or 961.

value: license to practice medicine and surgery
license_status_types.quote: The board may grant licenses, including various classes of temporary licenses, to practice medicine and surgery, to practice as an administrative physician, to practice perfusion, and to practice as an anesthesiologist assistant.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must provide a diploma from a credentialed foreign medical college, obtain ECFMG certification, pass all steps of the USMLE, and complete 24 months of accredited postgraduate training
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: an applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery who is a graduate of a foreign medical college must supply evidence satisfactory to the board of all of the following: 1. That the applicant is a graduate of and possesses a diploma from a foreign medical college credentialed by an agency approved by the board. 2. That the applicant has obtained certification by the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates or a successor organization. 3. That the applicant has passed all steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination administered by the National Board of Medical Examiners and the Federation of State Medical Boards, or their successor organizations.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: The applicant has successfully completed and received credit for 24 months of postgraduate training in one or more programs accredited by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the American Osteopathic Association, or a successor organization.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: a physician assistant who provides care to patients shall maintain and provide to the board upon request one of the following: a. Evidence that, pursuant to the physician assistant's employment, there is a physician who is primarily responsible for the overall direction and management of the physician assistant's professional activities ... b. A written collaborative agreement with a physician that ... describes the physician assistant's individual scope of practice

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may order, prescribe, procure, dispense, and administer prescription drugs, medical devices, services, and supplies consistent with their experience, education, and training
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: Subject to subd. 2. and any rules promulgated by the board and consistent with his or her experience, education, and training, a physician assistant may order, prescribe, procure, dispense, and administer prescription drugs, medical devices, services, and supplies.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Information contained in reports filed with the board under s. 49.45 (2) (a) 12r., 50.36 (3) (b), 609.17 or 632.715, or under 42 CFR 1001.2005, shall be investigated by the board.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Upon the request of a hospital, the board shall provide the hospital with all information relating to a licensee's loss, reduction or suspension of staff privileges from other hospitals and all information relating to the licensee's being found guilty of unprofessional conduct.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The board may require a person holding a license or certificate to undergo and may consider the results of one or more physical, mental or professional competency examinations if the board believes that the results of any such examinations may be useful to the board in conducting its investigation.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The board may grant an administrative physician license to an applicant who satisfies the requirements under s. 448.05 (2c). The board shall issue a license under this paragraph subject to the same terms as a license issued under par. (a), except that ... the holder of a license issued under this paragraph may not engage in the practice of medicine and surgery except as otherwise authorized under s. 448.03 (2)

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The board may grant a temporary license to practice medicine and surgery for a period not to exceed 90 days to a nonresident physician who is serving on a full-time or temporary basis in a camp or other recreational facility, or to a physician temporarily maintaining the practice of another physician.
